description: Header file defining the interface for Nordic Semiconductor's GRTC timer driver in Zephyr RTOS, including function prototypes, type definitions, and constants for timer operations.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_chan_alloc
methods.description: Allocates a GRTC capture/compare channel, returning channel ID or -ENOMEM.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_chan_free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated GRTC channel.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_read
methods.description: Reads the current absolute time from the GRTC timer.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_compare_evt_check
methods.description: Checks if a compare event has been generated for a given channel.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_compare_evt_address_get
methods.description: Gets the register address for the compare event.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_capture_task_address_get
methods.description: Gets the register address for the capture task.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_compare_int_lock
methods.description: Disables compare event interrupt safely, returning a key.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_compare_int_unlock
methods.description: Enables compare event interrupt based on the key.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_compare_read
methods.description: Reads the compare register value for a channel.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_set
methods.description: Sets a compare channel to a target time with a callback handler.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_abort
methods.description: Aborts a timer set with z_nrf_grtc_timer_set.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_get_ticks
methods.description: Converts system clock time to GRTC ticks.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_capture_prepare
methods.description: Prepares a channel for timestamp capture.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_timer_capture_read
methods.description: Reads the timestamp value captured on a channel.

methods.name: z_nrf_grtc_wakeup_prepare
methods.description: Prepares GRTC as a wake-up source and sets wake-up time.

methods.name: nrf_grtc_timer_clock_driver_init
methods.description: Initializes the GRTC clock timer driver.
